messages:
Maggie Chen: quick sync: proposing a tiny client hint header `x-rw-precision-hint: latency|balanced|quality`. runtime will map to precision lanes (4bit/int8/fp8) and return `x-rw-assigned-precision`. want to validate cache and scheduler impacts before formal RFC.
José Alvarez: seems useful. concern: abuse where everyone requests quality. how do we gate it?
Sam Patel: enforce via account flags + per-key rate limits. also record reason codes for assignment so we can audit.
Kaira Nair: cache note: precision affects KV cache keying. we should namespace caches by lane (`base_key:prec=lane`) to avoid correctness issues. expect higher warmup costs.
Ben Ops: add per-lane billing and metrics so finance can see cost delta. tokens_by_precision, token_cost_tags, etc.
quant-bot: telemetry proposal: emit `precision_hint`, `precision_assigned`, `precision_reason`, `cache_hit`, `model` as span tags.
Sam Patel: scheduler impact: do not mix lanes in a batch. implement per-lane queues and batch builders. consider a merge-on-timeout fallback to avoid starvation (e.g., if wait > 50ms).
Kaira Nair: testing: A/B prompt sets per-model for canary to check degscore and token divergence. auto-fallback rule: if degscore delta > 0.05 over 15min, shift customers to higher-fidelity lane.
Maggie Chen: rollout: phase 0 telemetry-only, phase 1 opt-in canary (5%), phase 2 beta with account enforcement, GA behind tier controls. keep pricing unchanged until we have stable telemetry.
Ben Ops: ops runbook: warm caches for precision lanes before cutover (30-60m), console global fallback toggle to force full-precision, per-customer override.
Action items: José spec enforcement + headers; Sam prototype per-lane queues + merge-on-timeout; Kaira build eval harness and dashboards; Ben draft runbook and toggles; Maggie own rollout doc.
